data.selection_source: Saved TRAIN split only; validation/test never used

method.search: Hierarchical: evaluation threads then batch/order; training threads then microbatch size. This is not an exhaustive joint search.
method.timing: Eval includes collation, forward and scoring; train includes collation, forward/backward/clip/AdamW and work counters. The historical real_task compute timer excluded collation. Thread switching, adapter restoration and fresh optimizer creation are outside microbenchmark timing; whole-run follow-up includes them. Use whole-run wall time for the final speed claim.
method.training_work: Same ordered four-example global batches and one update each. Microbatch mean losses weighted by examples/global size. Identical saved adapter and fresh AdamW restored before each trajectory.
method.precision: FP32 only; SDPA; no truncation changes, quantization, skipped examples or reduced validation.
method.selection: Tuning only; require identical eval predictions and small logit differences. Training allows declared adapter-update and confirmation-logit tolerances; whole-run quality must be checked separately.
method.memory: Sampled process RSS; same process can retain allocator memory across variants, so per-variant values are not isolated memory requirements.
